cards.claim: Prospekt Mira is a station of the Moscow Metro's Belorusskaya line.
cards.quote: Prospekt Mira (Russian: Проспе́кт Ми́ра) is a station of the Moscow Metro's Belorusskaya line. Opened on 30 January 1952 as part of the second stage of the line, it is a pylon design by architects Vladimir Gelfreykh and Mikhail Minkus.
